study.question: Does adding an explicit field-query/value interaction improve the complete balanced-history model, and is any product advantage greater with target queries than with history-context queries at both attention and classifier-feature sites?
study.hypothesis: Observed local limitation: the parent _read maps two field-specific value reads to their sum and gives the classifier only the norm-matched sum. Query-by-key products exist inside the scalar scorer, but not as explicit classifier features. Query effects through normalized weights disappear within singleton groups; adding a direct interaction may expose field relevance without the failed four-slot expansion. This is an architectural observation, not evidence that it causes validation error. Parent diagnostics on the first 512 impressions report field attention L1 1.1793 and occupied groups 2.0254, with meaningful target/context summary sensitivity 0.2545 RMS. Historical single-seed AUC: paired_match 0.6191087654, target_separate 0.6153351064, hybrid_target_separate 0.6198705488, hybrid_context_separate 0.6200552833, balanced_target 0.6202303849, balanced_context 0.6200080603, balanced_uniform 0.6199768224, global_uniform 0.6201325064. Target conditioning is therefore modest and inconsistent across design changes. Magnitude_target 0.6196326415 and groupnorm_target 0.6199113683 lost AUC; density_context 0.6201514113 exceeded density_target 0.6199695090. Latest slots_target 0.6198645158 and slots_context 0.6198232624 both lost to the balanced parent; collapsed_target 0.6194235507 and collapsed_context 0.6198655362 show a strong design interaction rather than uniform target benefit. Some losing-AUC norm designs improved logloss; metric tradeoffs must be retained. Provisional mechanism: a small direct multiplicative field-relevance feature may be more useful than retaining all four group slots. No complementarity, novelty, or generalization claim is established. The final 2x2 uses the same query-source factor at both attention and extra-feature sites. This supplies matched-capacity context-query readout controls, while preserving target-based group membership in every cell. An overall target/context difference alone cannot isolate the new feature; use the interaction with product/addition and the accepted balanced target/context references.

nearest_work.difference: Retain all original 420 features and the corresponding 16-dimensional balanced target/context summary; append a separate 16-dimensional explicit query/value feature. Query source is a factorial factor at both sites; existing query/key products only affect scalar attention weights.

Previous branch exposes four weighted group slots and widens the head by 48 relative to the parent, but loses AUC. This branch retains the parent and appends 16 product/addition coordinates; no new group slots.

DIN uses ad-conditioned weighted pooling and explicit interactions in its local activation. Those ideas are inherited and are not novel here. The local reference normalizes weights, unlike the original DIN paper; current intervention concerns additional classifier features after the fixed local readout.

UniDot routes per-layer candidate/retrieved-vector dot products and Grams to a classifier. We adapt only the explicit relevance readout principle: one elementwise product vector from category/brand values, norm matched to the inherited pool, evaluated against target/context and additive replacements. No stacked buses, dot Gram, domain inputs, delayed supervision, optimizer change or distillation. Source tiny-mode ablations are external and capacity confounded; not a local reproduction or general novelty claim.

Author README verifies category/brand/type history without item IDs. We use only these permitted fields plus supplied event age. Publisher full paper is unavailable here; no detailed DMR mechanism or reproduction claim.

inherited_components: Complete paired_match learned match-group means, observed category/brand joint counts and group/action/age histogram

Equal occupied-match-group mass, separate category/brand attention and norm matching from balanced_target/context; the query-source factor selects the corresponding accepted readout in all four cells.
Shared static/history embedding tables, action and log-age embeddings, original MLP widths and training recipe
The corresponding normalized 16-dimensional target/context retrieval feature remains as a separate classifier input.
Explicit candidate/history relevance is prior work (DIN scalar activation; UniDot classifier highway); broad novelty unverified
study.proposed_difference: Let vc=sum_i wc_i*(category_i+0.5*common_i) and vb=sum_i wb_i*(brand_i+0.5*common_i); vc+vb equals the parent raw summary up to reduction roundoff. New product feature is N(qc*vc+qb*vb), with elementwise multiplication and N the inherited norm matching to the global history mean. Active additive replacement is N(0.5*(qc+vc+qb+vb)). Query q is either static target category/brand embeddings or target-independent uniform history category/brand means. The target/context factor is applied at BOTH the inherited attention scorer and the extra feature. Thus target cells retain the balanced_target readout, and context cells use the balanced_context readout at matched capacity. Every cell retains target-dependent groups; context queries are independent of target embeddings, not a globally target-free representation. Concatenate original 420 features, corresponding inherited 16-vector and new 16-vector. Evaluate product and addition in every cell, select one, identical learned allocations. The new 452-wide head adds 2048 parameters versus parent and 4096 fewer than the failed 484-wide slot branch. Exact empty histories yield zero history features; cancellation falls back to the inherited pooled vector. This is a local value-interaction intervention, not evidence of a generally new architecture.
predictions: interaction_target should exceed both frozen source bests and balanced_target in full-population validation AUC if this extra path has incremental utility; report logloss separately, without choosing after seeing scores.

Conditioning support requires interaction_target to exceed interaction_context at identical capacity, but this also changes inherited attention. Product specificity needs interaction_target to exceed addition_target; stronger incremental target-by-value support requires positive factorial interaction: (AUC interaction_target - AUC interaction_context) - (AUC addition_target - AUC addition_context). Compare existing balanced_target/context difference as an external lower-capacity reference, not a capacity-matched contrast. All results remain single-seed observations until paired repetitions.

At a fixed checkpoint with inherited reads held fixed, replacing only the extra-feature query or swapping category/brand value vectors should change product features for some nondegenerate impressions. These local sensitivity probes do not enact the full trained query-factor comparison and do not establish predictive or causal utility.

Partition, masking, equal-group mass, field-sum reconstruction and norm invariants should hold within floating point tolerance; padding and history permutation must not materially change logits. Empty-mask and zero-length outputs must be finite.

Predeclared exploratory slices use only existing host bins: empty, 1-16, 17-64, >64 histories; hour bins; behavior present/absent; training frequency and missing/unseen fields when host provides them. Report sample/positive/negative counts and mark insufficient bins. No subgroup is claimed confirmatory from this adaptive search.
falsifiers: If interaction_target fails to exceed balanced_target or paired_match, added utility is unsupported despite any feature sensitivity.

If context-product or target-additive matches/exceeds target-product, a target-specific multiplicative advantage is unsupported; a gain over historical references alone is insufficient. The target/context comparison changes attention as well as the extra feature, so use the 2x2 interaction for additional product specificity.
A zero/negative factorial AUC interaction, opposite logloss direction, seed reversal or predominantly fallback features weakens the narrow hypothesis and must be reported.
Nonfinite forward/backward or masking/empty/permutation violations invalidate the implementation rather than refuting the scientific mechanism.
A cost increase beyond useful validation quality/cost tradeoffs rules out an efficiency claim even if AUC improves.
alternative_explanations: Different feature directions, higher moments, fallback frequencies and embedding gradients remain despite equal norm and parameter allocation.

Context values in the new path derive from the same history and can be predictive. Context-query cells still use target-match partitions. Query changes at both read sites mean an overall target advantage alone does not isolate the extra product path.
Additive replacement carries duplicated query and read signals; it is an active equal-capacity replacement, not a mathematically equivalent null.
Scratch training changes shared embeddings and attention in response to the new path; fixed-checkpoint perturbations describe sensitivity, not a trained causal effect.
Historical source/incumbent comparisons have different classifier widths and seed-sensitive initialization. Only the current factorial has identical allocations.
Seed 42 research comparisons are preliminary; repeated deterministic replays of existing controls are not independent evidence.

Any gain can reflect extra active classifier capacity, changed random head initialization, regularization or a useful nonlinear feature basis rather than recovery of lost information. Product is derivable from visible inputs; no claim that the full parent network cannot approximate it.
Repeated adaptive use of validation may overfit selection. No holdout is available to address this in this phase.
Static publisher snapshot as-of dates are undocumented. This remains a benchmark availability assumption, not production point-in-time validation.
